text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaa! This is incredible! That's incredible too, everything is incredible!
choice_data_list: What are you looking at with such enthusiasm?
What are you looking at with such enthusiasm?

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: Hm, an Academy Trainer. Look at this, right here.
choice_data_list: A solo exhibition... Abstract paintings? Are you into art?

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: Not at all. Even if you call it abstract art, I have no clue what's going on.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: However, the paintings here are magnificent! Look closely. Every single one is drawn entirely with straight lines.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: Beautiful, far too beautiful. To think a human could draw such clean, precise straight lines! I am deeply moved!

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: I must convey my impressions to the creator at all costs. Fan mail? Social media? No, those are all too slow!

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: Meeting directly in person to tell them is undeniably the fastest. I shall go right this instant—
choice_data_list: Hold on! Do you even know where they are?
Hold on! Do you even know where they are?

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: No. But as long as I keep running in a straight line, I will arrive there eventually. Without a doubt.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Since that was far too reckless, I instead inquired about the painter's whereabouts and arranged an appointment to meet them directly—

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: Pleased to meet you. Straight to the point. The paintings you create—they are magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: Not only is the beauty of the straight lines striking, but a world expressed solely through straight lines is supreme. That is the true utopia for lovers of straight lines.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: Unless one loves straight lines and is loved by them as much as I am, creating such art is impossible. Please, I implore you, continue drawing beautiful straight lines from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Painter
text_block_list.text: ...Haha, I've been painting for a long time, but this is the first time I've ever received such passionate praise. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Painter
text_block_list.text: However... lately, my lines haven't been flowing as I wish. I was thinking it's about time to lay down my paintbrush.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: What?! No more such beautiful straight lines will be born? Impossible, that is a loss to the entire world!

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: Very well, then I shall become the successor to this monumental endeavor.
choice_data_list: Wait, Light O? What are you saying—

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: Rest assured. For it is I.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: I shall prove it right now. Once you see the straight lines I draw, you will have no choice but to acknowledge it.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: Seeei! ...Hm, something is off. Then how about this! Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: ...No, the beauty of that straight line was far beyond this. Once more, teeei!

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Kuh, no good! No matter how many times I draw,
it's simply no match for that beautiful straight line!

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
As I thought, hands won't do the trick!
In that case, with these legs—!

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: HAAAAAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Painter
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe, a line that was about to break off
has just been connected.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Saying so, the painter drew a single line
on the sketchbook Karston Light O
had left behind—

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text: How was that? The straight line of my running was—hm?

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
This straight line... What gives?
You can draw one after all.
So you lied to me earlier! You scamp!

text_block_list.name: Painter
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yeah. Seems I was lying to myself.
Looks like I've still got lines
left in me to draw.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Oho! Then that means you're retracting your retirement?
That calls for celebration! Yahoo!

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
However, the straight line I just drew with my sprint
was quite a masterpiece if I do say so myself.
Honestly, it doesn't lose to your straight line at all.

text_block_list.name: Karston Light O
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, from this moment on, you are my rival.
Let's see whose straight line is more beautiful,
yours or mine! A showdown!

text_block_list.name: Painter
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, sounds fun.
As a pro, I can't afford to lose this one.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Burning with competitive fire even against someone she admired,
Karston Light O remained completely unaware
that she had just saved an artist's soul.
